Broad umbrella chiefly covering oral/salivary and upper-airway neoplasms; other anatomical sites depend on subtype.

Inherited platelet aggregation defect; mucocutaneous bleeding does not establish separate organ damage. Intracranial hemorrhage is uncommon overall.

Defined by fusion and ankylosis of distal interphalangeal joints; nail findings have unspecified frequency.
Myeloid blood and marrow neoplasia defines this concept; damage from the preceding cancer treatment is not additional disease involvement.
Congenital deafness and generalized albinism define the syndrome; ocular dysfunction, hypogonadism and intellectual disability lack frequency evidence.
Limb/jaw defects and congenital splenic fusion define it; oral, lung and cardiac defects are mostly <30%. Frequent skin abnormality lacks damage details.
Alcohol-induced dilated cardiomyopathy directly damages myocardium; other alcohol-associated diseases are separate conditions.
Neurodevelopmental/neurodegenerative syndrome; strabismus occurs in 80-99%, and scoliosis or clubfoot in 30-79%. Constipation alone does not establish gut damage.
Fibromuscular obstruction below the aortic valve is a structural cardiac outflow disorder.
Complex congenital heart malformations dominate MMP21-related heterotaxy; intestinal malrotation frequency is unspecified, and polysplenia need not impair function.
Peripheral neuropathy and sensorineural hearing impairment are both defining features.
Cholesterol synthesis disorder; neurodevelopmental impairment affects most patients in the major subtypes, Smith-Lemli-Opitz syndrome and desmosterolosis.
Congenital ichthyosis; supplied HPO reports digit autoamputation and ectropion each in 30-79%, supporting limb loss and eyelid dysfunction.
Inherited tryptophan metabolism disorder; neurological injury varies by subtype and is not established in at least 30% across this umbrella.
Facial spasm is a neurological movement disorder; hyporeflexia supports nervous system involvement, while anisocoria alone does not establish eye damage.
Global developmental delay and hypotonia occur in 30-79%; ocular, skeletal and skin abnormalities are individually reported in only 5-29%.
Treatment-resistant hematopoietic malignancy; lymphoma is only one subtype, so an immune mechanism label does not apply across the umbrella.
